title: VibeSec G4 模型審查紀錄 / VibeSec G4 LLM Review Record
description: 一次 G4 LLM 審查（docs/05 自動化作法第 2 點、docs/09）的紀錄，由 harness 寫到 reports/g4-review.yaml，人工複製為 reviews/g4/<commit>.yaml 提交。CI 據此把 VS-G4-LLM-REVIEW 從 pending 推進到有結論。紀錄只陳述審查發生了什麼：意見全部保留、不多數決、requires_human 的發現仍須 rulings/ 裁決；它本身不能把閘門變成 pass。 / Record of a G4 LLM review (docs/05 and docs/09). The harness writes reports/g4-review.yaml; a human submits reviews/g4/<commit>.yaml. Retain all opinions, never majority-vote, and resolve human-required findings through rulings/. The record cannot pass a gate by itself.

commit.description: 審查時被測專案的 HEAD（完整 40 碼）。CI 只接受「此 commit 之後只動過 reviews/g4/ 與 rulings/」的 PR head / Full 40-character reviewed target HEAD. CI accepts only later changes confined to reviews/g4/ and rulings/.

roles.description: 本次實際執行的角色；必須涵蓋 vibesec.yaml gates.g4_access_control_review.roles / Roles actually executed; must cover configured G4 roles.

prompt_versions.description: 角色 → config/harness/roles/<role>.md 頂端的 prompt_version / Role to prompt_version in config/harness/roles/<role>.md frontmatter.

providers.description: 每個被呼叫的 provider 與其狀態；缺席者照實記 missing / timeout / error，資料分級不允許而未送出記 refused（docs/09 §11），不補假意見 / Actual provider states: missing/timeout/error, or refused when data policy prevented transmission. Never fabricate opinions (docs/09 section 11).

provider.description: config/providers.yaml 的 provider 名稱，或 claude-code-subagent（SKILL.md 步驟 2） / Provider name from config/providers.yaml, or claude-code-subagent (skill step 2).

state.description: refused：資料分級不在該 provider 的 allowed_data_classes，未送出任何內容（review_provider.py exit 3） / Refused means data class is not allowed; no content was sent (review_provider.py exit 3).

coverage.description: LLM 審查涵蓋的控制與結論；至少要有 VS-G4-LLM-REVIEW / Controls and conclusions covered by LLM review; must include VS-G4-LLM-REVIEW.

findings.description: 本次審查產生或審查過的 G4 發現（與 reports/findings.json 同 id）。可為空陣列 / G4 findings created/reviewed here, using the same IDs as reports/findings.json; may be empty.

evidence_grade.description: 只有模型意見時最高 E2（docs/09 §4）；E3 需人工裁決（rulings/） / Model-only evidence is at most E2; E3 requires a human ruling.

handle.description: 把 reports/g4-review.yaml 複製進 reviews/g4/ 的人（GitHub 帳號）。harness 產出時留空字串；空白 = 未經人確認，紀錄不能把 G4 推到 pass。由本 PR 新增的紀錄，此值不得是 PR 作者，且必須是在目前 head 上 approve 的人之一 / Human GitHub handle copying the report into reviews/g4/. The harness leaves it blank, which is untrusted. For records added by this PR, the recorder must not be the author and must personally approve the current head.

raw_ref.description: 原始審查輸出的位置（reports/raw/… 或 artifact），供稽核 / Raw review output path (reports/raw/... or artifact) for auditing.
